continuity: The fifteen-day treatment of Jeok Cheongang is on its fourth day, and Jin Taekyung continues guarding him in the underground prison.
The Qilian Three Fiends have submitted to the Western Heaven Demon Lord, who has killed the Poison King and the Heaven-Shaking Venerable Nun at the cost of one arm.
The Heavenly Power Demon is imprisoned in the Sichuan Tang Clan's underground prison with severed limb sinews and unusually heavy restraints.
plot: The Western Heaven Demon Lord gathers hundreds of black-robed hunters and receives the submission of the Qilian Three Fiends. He reveals that the Poison King and the Heaven-Shaking Venerable Nun are dead, their lives costing him one arm, and declares that the time has come to begin his plans.

On the fourth day of Jeok Cheongang's treatment, Jin Taekyung mentally spars with Cheongpung before luring him away with rumors of an imperial chef. Taekyung then feeds the prisoners in the underground prison and learns that the quietest prisoner, the Heavenly Power Demon, is the man who urinated on the Kunlun Sect's signboard.
translation_decisions: Render 기련산 as Qilian Mountains, 기련삼괴 as Qilian Three Fiends, 삼괴 as Three Fiends, and 삼노 as Three Old Men.
Render 난화수 as Chaotic Flower Hand, 천하일단 as One Cut Under Heaven, and 매화삼릉검 as Plum Blossom Three-Ridge Sword.
Render 채양보음 descriptively as harvesting yang to replenish yin.

active_continuity: Jin Taekyung possesses the Myriad-Poison Ring, but Item Appraisal says a special condition is required to appraise it.

The Divine Physician and Mungyeong are on the fourth day of a fifteen-day treatment of Jeok Cheongang using the ring and Cold-Ice Stone in the deepest underground prison cell of the Sichuan Tang Clan.
Jeok Cheongang remains unconscious and critically ill with Formless Ultimate Poison.
Jin Taekyung recognizes Jeok Cheongang as his Master and continues guarding him during the treatment.
Venerable Myoryeong remains under treatment for the Black Hand Seal.
The Western Heaven Demon Lord is a one-armed middle-aged martial artist who killed the Poison King and the Heaven-Shaking Venerable Nun.
The Western Heaven Demon Lord commands hundreds of black-robed hunters summoned through a concealed Mystic Gate Formation.
The Qilian Three Fiends from the Qilian Mountains have submitted to the Western Heaven Demon Lord.
The Western Heaven Demon Lord intends to hunt Emei, Qingcheng, and the Sichuan Tang Clan.
The Heavenly Power Demon is imprisoned in the Sichuan Tang Clan's underground prison with severed limb sinews and heavy restraints.
open_questions: Will the Divine Physician's fifteen-day treatment save Jeok Cheongang?
What special condition is required to appraise the Myriad-Poison Ring?
Can Emei, Qingcheng, and the Sichuan Tang Clan withstand the Western Heaven Demon Lord's planned hunt?
What is the identity and purpose of the Lord of Heaven invoked by the Western Heaven Demon Lord?
Will Venerable Myoryeong fully recover from the Black Hand Seal?

profile_creations.personality: Bloodthirsty and notorious throughout Qinghai, but fearful and submissive before the Western Heaven Demon Lord.
profile_creations.relationships: They serve the Western Heaven Demon Lord and address him as their superior.
profile_creations.role: Three brothers from the barren land of Qinghai who hid near the Qilian Mountains before returning under the name Qilian Three Fiends.
profile_creations.voice: The brothers speak in near-unison with frightened, deferential phrasing.

profile_creations.personality: Quiet and self-possessed despite his severe imprisonment.
profile_creations.relationships: He is one of the notorious martial criminals imprisoned by the Sichuan Tang Clan and is the man who urinated on the Kunlun Sect's signboard.
profile_creations.role: An elderly prisoner in the Sichuan Tang Clan's underground prison whose limb sinews were severed and whose restraints are heavier than those of the other prisoners.
profile_creations.voice: Gruff and dry, with formal self-reference as 노부.

profile_updates.current: - **Relationships:** Tang Taesang resisted his torture; he considers Emei, Qingcheng, and the Sichuan Tang Clan prey and commands hundreds of black-robed hunters summoned through a concealed Mystic Gate Formation.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Relationships:** Tang Taesang and the Heaven-Shaking Venerable Nun were his latest victims, he lost one arm taking their lives, and the Qilian Three Fiends now submit to him alongside his hundreds of black-robed hunters.
